//Wolverine: The event card hw_tgr_wolverine spawns: the wolverine's whole presence in the world (plan section 14), in the shape of hw_event_blackbear.json. One popup, one button; clicking it destroys exactly ONE card of the 8 in AffectedCardsWarpData (all vanilla trap catches, by GUID, read from the four triggered traps' InventoryFilter.AcceptedCardsWarpData, wave0-threats.md section 6) found in the LOCATION row of the current location or inside a container there (AppliesTo 6 = AllCardsInLocation, LookInInventories true), never the ground row, the hand or an equipment slot. The button cannot be confined to traps (ExtraDurabilityChange.AffectsCard tests only the affected card), so a catch card kept in a placed chest or shelf is reachable too; README says so. The list is disjoint from the eagle's and the black bear's lists (raids.md distinct-from-vanilla test): the hare, duck, squirrel, mouse, frog and partridge catches are the eagle's. No NoCardsAffectedMessage on purpose (a second after-spawning pass would show it as a SECOND popup right after a successful take; see hw_event_blackbear.json), so a click with nothing to take is silent.

CardDescription.DefaultText: A wolverine, hungry in the deep of winter, has found your trapline and is nosing at the sprung traps. It may find nothing worth taking.

CustomDestroyMessage.DefaultText: The wolverine tears a catch from the traps and drags it off:
